# Ferroelectric_ComputeInMemory

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware architecture that performs computation directly within ferroelectric memory arrays, enabling analog in-memory processing of neural dynamical systems. This bridges memory and computation, reducing data movement overhead critical for real-time forecasting in neuromorphic and topology-centric computing.
